catalog_item_graded_fields.name: catalog_item_graded_fields
catalog_item_graded_fields.value: ("catalog_item"."kind" = 'graded') = ("catalog_item"."grader" is not null and "catalog_item"."grade" is not null) and ("catalog_item"."grader" is null) = ("catalog_item"."grade" is null)

listing_custom_graded.name: listing_custom_graded
listing_custom_graded.value: "listing"."catalog_item_id" is not null or "listing"."kind" <> 'graded' or ("listing"."grader" is not null and "listing"."grade" is not null)

sale_payment_note.name: sale_payment_note
sale_payment_note.value: ("sale"."payment_method" = 'other') = ("sale"."payment_note" is not null) and char_length("sale"."payment_note") between 1 and 40

public.active_hold.definition: select rl.listing_id, rl.request_id, r.store_id, rl.qty, r.expires_at from request_line rl join request r on r.id = rl.request_id where r.status = 'pending' and r.expires_at > now()
public.active_hold.name: active_hold
